body.x: SPACEJUMP (CEO Bae SangIl) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, USA, at the K-Startup Pavilion.

SPACEJUMP provides automated solutions to streamline entrepreneurs’ processes, from launching to closing businesses. The company focuses on creating a transparent and secure trading environment for used equipment, primarily targeting the food service industry.

The company’s solutions digitize the trading system for business equipment and kitchen appliances, improving transparency compared to traditional informal markets. This ensures rational and secure transactions between businesses.

At CES 2025, SPACEJUMP will introduce its solution, Sosang Gongan, an AI-powered platform for evaluating the value and specifications of used goods. The platform's AI-based pricing model lets users input basic product details, such as the model name and usage period, to obtain pricing estimates quickly. The platform also automates comprehensive estimates for new or used equipment required for new establishments, utilizing patented AI technology to simplify trading and investment decisions.

Another standout feature is SPACEJUMP’s AI and LiDAR-based automatic measurement solution. By simply taking a photo, users can measure the dimensions and weight of equipment, ensuring accurate and reliable specifications. This technology enhances distributors’ efficiency in managing equipment, enabling buyers to assess the equipment’s size and optimize their space utilization plans.

In addition to trading capabilities, SPACEJUMP has partnered with freight transport platforms and convenience store courier services to offer a seamless logistics system through Sosang Gongan. This system allows users to book transportation and delivery services directly through the platform. Items weighing over 20kg can be delivered on the same day at reasonable costs, and the delivery status can be tracked in real-time.

A SPACEJUMP representative stated, “Sosang Gongan is expanding its footprint in Seoul. We offer automated inspection, pricing evaluation, and transaction services for sellers and buyers in the used equipment market. We have also established strong relationships with domestic food franchise brands, earning recognition for reliability and convenience.”

The representative added, “Looking ahead, we aim to enter global markets with a high density of small businesses, such as Vietnam, South America, and Southern Europe. Our goal at CES 2025 is to identify global investors and partners, laying the groundwork for collaboration with major used equipment companies in these regions. By enhancing brand recognition for Sosang Gongan, we plan to accelerate growth and drive our international expansion efforts.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
